messages:
elaine: quick sync — q2 hosted surface planning. we're getting pressure from 2 mid-market customers for: 1) embeddings P99 latency under 120ms for search flow, 2) streaming chat with token-level events + partial completions, 3) deterministic top-k rerank API for ranking pipelines. can we fit all into q2 slice? thinking: embeddings perf + caching optimizations (low-risk), streaming requires runtime frontdoor + SDK updates, deterministic rerank needs model variant + seed support. thoughts?

sam: +1 on embedding caching. quick cost note: to hit 120ms p99 we need prefix/KV caching + quantized 8-bit on A100s — estimate +15% infra cost.

jaime: rerank ask — customers want exact top-k reproducibility. that implies deterministic sampling or argmax-only endpoint. we can ship argmax-only as v1. smaller API change.

maria: streaming SDK work is nontrivial — JS/py SDKs need new event hooks. also need console UX for streaming logs. estimate 3 sprints.

kevin: infra constraint — current hosted capacity for embeddings is saturated during peak. to lower p99 we'd need dedicated node pool + autoscale rules or improved batching. can we prioritize cache/in-memory KV first?

elaine: proposed priority: (A) embeddings perf (cache + quant) -> quick win, (B) deterministic rerank (argmax endpoint) -> medium, (C) streaming chat -> stretch. launch criteria listed below.

jaime: agree. for rerank can we reuse existing /ras endpoints? also need to add `seed` param to ensure determinism.

sam: for embeddings perf rollout plan: canary on 5% traffic, metrics: token p99, 95th percentile compute ms, cost/tokens. rollback triggers: p99 increase >10% or error rate >0.5% for 5m.

elaine: good — draft launch criteria: - p99 embeddings <120ms on representative customer workload - cost delta <= +20% or offset by cache hit rates - rerank: deterministic mode returns stable top-k on repeat calls - streaming: latency per token <50ms for 90% tokens in canary - observability: route-level dashboards + tracing enabled.

kevin: add ops requirement: warm pools + readiness probes, canary scheduler to move from 5%->25%->100% with health gates every 30m. i'll provide schedule.

maria: i'll scope SDK PRs and console tweaks. estimate: embeddings caching + rerank argmax = 2 sprints if we parallelize infra + SDK. streaming needs separate epic.

elaine: ok action items: kevin sends canary schedule by EOD Thu, sam to run perf bench for quantized embeddings by Wed, maria/jaime to prepare API change RFC for rerank by next Mon. we'll review in planning sync Friday 10am. @kevin @sam @maria @jaime :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline check — canary pipeline templates available at https://git.redwood/devops/canary-templates.

jaime: noted. one more ask — customers want contract language for determinism SLA. legal wants telemetry to prove determinism; we should record deterministic test IDs in audit logs.

elaine: good point. add audit log requirement to launch criteria. final: agree to A/B commit for streaming only in q3 unless we deprioritize another slice.

maria: ack. i'll update the epic cards.

sam: will start bench runs tonight.

elaine: thanks team — closing thread, will recap in the Friday doc.
